items.statement: Within the validated investigated network, the sulfonyl-substituted system supports kinetic preference for the [4+2] channel over the [2+2] channel.
items.expected: The conclusion identifies [4+2] as preferred, gives the signed barrier comparison when available, and limits interpretation to the investigated model/network.

items.statement: The calculation is mechanistic support rather than an absolute product-ratio or globally unique excited-state proof.
items.expected: Limitations mention conformers, method/solvation/spin treatment and the bounded pathway search.
